receipts.method: Red drill MAC-AC-01-MACOS-writable on the owner's MacBook Pro (macOS 15.7.9 24G830, Intel x86_64), owner-approved 2026-11-15, launched from here over ssh with docs/delivery/reports/m1a/mac/job.sh's drills step: tests/drills/run.py, with Homebrew's Python 3.13.7, PyQt6 6.11.0 and pytest 9.2.0 in a venv of its own (packaging/requirements-test.txt, hash-locked; reports/m1a/mac/context-observed.txt), in a temporary copy of a4fe9f8's files (git archive; the unpacked tree checked against the commit's, 6fa4a57f). a4fe9f8 is wave4/mac-drills with improve/assessment-fixes merged (cbeed17, the toast merge, and 86e84e0, the quit guard), which changed none of this criterion's files since 3586a0d. Green; then in _MACOS_ROOT '-o -perm +022' became '-o -name nothing', so find no longer reports a file that group or others can write, and test_mac_an_app_others_could_change_is_never_run_as_root failed in its own body (tests/test_install_update.py:287): the root script exited 0, having run the copied app's install-update and installed, where 3 and the refusal were asserted; the file's bytes were put back (SHA-256 checked) and it passed again. The plan's own text for this drill (W4C-RED-AC-01-MACOS: '! -user root -o -perm +022' becoming '-name nothing') was run too, as MAC-AC-01-MACOS-plan-text in the same log: it also takes out the '! -user root' that the test's fixture puts the test user's uid into, so the test errors at setup on that guard ("'! -user root' isn't in the script any more") before the script runs. That proves the guard, not the check, so this receipt binds the drill that keeps that text. The '! -user root' half itself can't be drilled by this test: every file in the test's copy is the test user's own, and only root can make one someone else's. The same drills went green, red and green on 3586a0d earlier the same day (reports/m1a/mac/3586a0d/). The command is the one run there; the receipt's environment is the plan's profile (ROADMAP: evidence from elsewhere).
